excluded_capabilities.name: metacircular-utilities-composition
excluded_capabilities.reason: Installing utils.scm through the scoped metacircular evaluator re-evaluates serialized quasiquote expansion containing internal <list*>; unified does not expose or execute that internal operator dynamically. The profile therefore validates scoped evaluator installation separately, then validates unchanged Utilities source and expected expressions in single fresh-record queries; it does not claim durable Utilities installation through the archived metacircular composition gate.
